name.value: Souk Mediterranean - Dollar Store & Mediterranean Grocery

description.value: Souk Mediterranean is a Richmond grocery store specialising in pantry ingredients sourced from over 30 countries, with a catalogue of nearly 1,800 products including bread, dairy, canned goods, spices, halawa, tahini, grape leaves, and dried fruits. It doubles as a dollar store, making it a one-stop shop for both specialty Mediterranean staples and everyday essentials. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's Number 5 Road corridor will find an unusually wide selection of shelf-stable snacks, nuts, dried fruits, and drinks well-suited for topping up supplies on the road.
